paper.title_en: Dynamical entropy and thermodynamics of causal diamonds
paper.abstract_en: We study the dynamical entropy of causal diamonds using Wald-Zoupas charges and fluxes on their null boundaries. For a chosen boundary symplectic potential, the boost charge defines an entropy made of an area term plus an expansion correction, which reduces to one quarter of the area at the edge on the diamond. In Einstein gravity, we find an exact balance law relating the entropy on any two cuts of the null boundary to a signed flux, so the entropy decreases only when this flux is non-negative. We obtain a linearised physical process first law without assuming a background Killing symmetry, both in the presence and absence of external matter; and extend it for semiclassical gravity based on the improved quantum null energy condition. We also examine causal diamonds in maximally symmetric spacetimes and in Einstein-scalar gravity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以 Wald-Zoupas 荷与通量研究因果金刚石零边界上的动力学熵，给出面积项加膨胀修正的熵定义与精确平衡律，并在不假设背景 Killing 对称性的情况下推导线性化物理过程第一定律，还扩展至基于改进量子零能条件（QNEC）的半经典引力；理论深度与新颖性较强，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞热力学交叉方向，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 因果金刚石的动力学熵与热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们利用因果金刚石零边界上的 Wald-Zoupas 荷与通量，研究其动力学熵。对于选定的边界辛势，boost 荷定义了一个由面积项加膨胀修正构成的熵，它在金刚石边缘退化为面积的四分之一。在爱因斯坦引力中，我们发现了一个精确的平衡律，将零边界任意两个截面上的熵与一个有符号通量联系起来，因此只有当该通量非负时熵才会减少。我们在不假设背景 Killing 对称性的情况下，分别在存在和不存在外部物质时，得到了线性化的物理过程第一定律；并基于改进的量子零能条件将其推广到半经典引力。我们还考察了最大对称时空以及爱因斯坦-标量引力中的因果金刚石。
